import pandas as pd
import numpy as np


def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    entity_ids = list(entity_ids)

    lookback_90 = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=90)
    lookback_180 = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=180)
    lookback_365 = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=365)

    orders = db["orders"]
    order_items = db["order_items"]
    reviews = db["reviews"]

    # Только покупки, совершённые до seed_time (момент известен в seed_time)
    orders_hist = orders[orders["order_purchase_timestamp"] <= seed_time]

    relevant_items = order_items[order_items["product_id"].isin(entity_ids)]
    items_full = relevant_items.merge(
        orders_hist[["order_id", "order_purchase_timestamp", "order_status"]],
        on="order_id",
        how="inner",
    )
    items_historic = items_full[items_full["order_purchase_timestamp"] <= seed_time]

    def agg_window(items, suffix):
        if len(items) == 0:
            return pd.DataFrame({"product_id": []})
        return items.groupby("product_id").agg(
            units_sold=("order_item_id", "count"),
            revenue=("price", "sum"),
            avg_price=("price", "mean"),
            total_freight=("freight_value", "sum"),
            unique_orders=("order_id", "nunique"),
            unique_sellers=("seller_id", "nunique"),
        ).rename(columns=lambda c: f"{c}_{suffix}").reset_index()

    items_7 = items_historic[items_historic["order_purchase_timestamp"] > seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=7)]
    items_30 = items_historic[items_historic["order_purchase_timestamp"] > seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=30)]
    items_90 = items_historic[items_historic["order_purchase_timestamp"] > lookback_90]
    items_180 = items_historic[items_historic["order_purchase_timestamp"] > lookback_180]
    items_365 = items_historic[items_historic["order_purchase_timestamp"] > lookback_365]

    agg_7 = agg_window(items_7, "7")
    agg_30 = agg_window(items_30, "30")
    agg_90 = agg_window(items_90, "90")
    agg_180 = agg_window(items_180, "180")
    agg_365 = agg_window(items_365, "365")

    # Recency
    if len(items_historic):
        last_purchase = items_historic.groupby("product_id")["order_purchase_timestamp"].max()
        first_purchase = items_historic.groupby("product_id")["order_purchase_timestamp"].min()
        recency = pd.DataFrame({
            "recency_days": (seed_time - last_purchase).dt.days,
            "age_days": (seed_time - first_purchase).dt.days,
        }).reset_index()
    else:
        recency = pd.DataFrame(columns=["product_id", "recency_days", "age_days"])

    # Тренд: продажи в последних 90 днях vs предыдущие 90 дней
    prev_90 = items_historic[
        (items_historic["order_purchase_timestamp"] > lookback_180) &
        (items_historic["order_purchase_timestamp"] <= lookback_90)
    ]
    units_prev_90 = prev_90.groupby("product_id")["order_item_id"].count().rename("units_prev_90").reset_index()

    # Отзывы: учитываем только отзывы, уже опубликованные к seed_time
    reviews_known = reviews[reviews["review_creation_date"] <= seed_time]
    items_reviews = items_historic.merge(
        reviews_known[["order_id", "review_score"]], on="order_id", how="left"
    )
    review_agg = items_reviews.groupby("product_id").agg(
        avg_review=("review_score", "mean"),
        total_reviews=("review_score", "count"),
        neg_reviews=("review_score", lambda s: (s <= 2).sum()),
    ).reset_index()
    if len(review_agg):
        review_agg["neg_share"] = review_agg["neg_reviews"] / review_agg["total_reviews"].replace(0, np.nan)
    else:
        review_agg["neg_share"] = pd.Series(dtype=float)

    # Статусы заказов (известно на seed_time)
    delivered_mask = items_historic["order_status"] == "delivered"
    status_agg = items_historic.groupby("product_id").agg(
        total_items_status=("order_item_id", "count"),
        delivered_items=("order_status", lambda s: (s == "delivered").sum()),
        canceled_items=("order_status", lambda s: (s == "canceled").sum()),
    ).reset_index()
    if len(status_agg):
        status_agg["canceled_share"] = status_agg["canceled_items"] / status_agg["total_items_status"].replace(0, np.nan)
    else:
        status_agg["canceled_share"] = pd.Series(dtype=float)

    final_features = pd.DataFrame({"product_id": entity_ids})
    for df in [agg_7, agg_30, agg_90, agg_180, agg_365, recency, units_prev_90, review_agg, status_agg]:
        final_features = final_features.merge(df, on="product_id", how="left")

    final_features = final_features.set_index("product_id")

    # Производные признаки
    if "units_90" in final_features.columns:
        final_features["trend_90"] = final_features["units_90"] - final_features["units_prev_90"].fillna(0)
        final_features["ratio_90_prev90"] = final_features["units_90"] / (final_features["units_prev_90"].fillna(0) + 1)
    if "units_180" in final_features.columns:
        final_features["units_90_share_180"] = final_features["units_90"] / (final_features["units_180"] + 1)

    fill_zero_cols = [c for c in final_features.columns
                      if c not in ("recency_days", "age_days", "avg_review", "avg_price_7",
                                   "avg_price_30", "avg_price_90", "avg_price_180",
                                   "avg_price_365", "neg_share", "canceled_share")]
    final_features[fill_zero_cols] = final_features[fill_zero_cols].fillna(0)

    for c in ["avg_review", "neg_share", "canceled_share",
              "avg_price_7", "avg_price_30", "avg_price_90",
              "avg_price_180", "avg_price_365"]:
        if c in final_features.columns:
            final_features[c] = final_features[c].fillna(0)

    final_features["recency_days"] = final_features["recency_days"].fillna(9999)
    final_features["age_days"] = final_features["age_days"].fillna(9999)

    final_features = final_features.reindex(entity_ids)
    final_features = final_features.astype(float)

    return final_features
